gotchas: Values are IEEE half-precision floats (Float16) in a single 16-bit register, NOT scaled integers. This is the opposite convention from the TriStar MPPT (per-unit integers) and from the TriStar PWM and SunSaver MPPT (fixed-constant integers). A driver cannot share a decode path across Morningstar lines.

The document contradicts itself on the charge-current limit. The EEPROM table has TWO registers: Eib_lim at 0xE013 "Battery Charge Current Limit" (units A, Float16) and Eic_lim at 0xE038 "Charge Current Limit" (units A, Float16). The glossary entry for Eib_lim then reads "[57364][0xE013] (V). Battery current." — units
MeterBus RJ-11 is the only port. There is no RS-232, no EIA-485 and no Ethernet on a ProStar MPPT — an MSC adapter (the 'PC MeterBus adapter' the retailer sells alongside) is mandatory, not optional.

charge_state (0x0021) adds a tenth value the TriStar MPPT does not have: 10 = FIXED (fixed-Vmp mode). Values 0-9 match the TriStar MPPT list, but do not take that as licence to share the map — every other address differs.

load_state (0x002E) has eight values: 0 START, 1 LOAD_ON, 2 LVD_WARNING, 3 LVD, 4 FAULT, 5 DISCONNECT, 6 LOAD_OFF, 7 OVERRIDE. Collapsing this to a boolean switch-state loses the LVD distinction, which is the one a cabin actually cares about.
unmappedReports: T_hs heatsink temperature (0x001A) and the three phase inductor temperatures T_ind[U]/[V]/[W] (0x001E-0x0020), Ahc_r / Ahc_t / Ahl_r / Ahl_t amp-hour counters (0x0026-0x0029, 0x0032-0x0035) — charge Ah and load Ah, neither has a kind, kWhc_r / kWhc_t (0x002A/0x002B), vb_ref regulator reference voltage (0x0024) and vb_ref_charge_slave (0x0025), array_fault (0x0022), load_fault (0x002F), alarm_HI/LO (0x0038/0x0039) bitfields, V_lvd and V_lhvd, the live low/high-voltage-disconnect thresholds (0x0030/0x0031), Tb_lo_limit_100 / Tb_lo_limit_0 cold-battery charge foldback limits (0x002C/0x002D), Sweep_Vmp / Sweep_Pmax / Sweep_Voc / va_ref (0x003D-0x0040), hourmeter (0x0036/0x0037), dip_switch (0x003A), led_state (0x003B), charge_led_state (0x004D), lighting_should_be_on (0x004E) — lighting-mode intent, distinct from actual load state, state-of-charge — not reported
